sections.title: Colour palette
sections.intro: The raw ramps every colour role points at, one family each. Reach for a role below rather than a step here: a role follows the theme and keeps its contrast, a step does not.

sections.title: Colour roles
sections.intro: What a colour is for: surfaces, text, borders, actions and feedback. These are the tokens a stylesheet uses, and each one changes with the theme (`data-theme`).

sections.title: Spacing, size, radius and borders
sections.intro: The fixed scales. A step's name is its size in pixels at the default root font size, so `--primitiv-space-16` is `1rem`.

sections.title: Typography
sections.intro: The type primitives. Text styles that change with density are under Type and layout.

sections.title: Opacity and interaction
sections.intro: The opacity scale, and the state treatments built on it.

sections.title: Elevation
sections.intro: Shadows. `--primitiv-elevation-*` names a depth; `--primitiv-shadow-*` is the ramp it draws from.

sections.title: Motion
sections.intro: Durations, easings, and the transitions named for what they move.

sections.title: Breakpoints
sections.intro: Custom properties cannot be read inside a media query, so these are for reference: write the value itself in `@media`.

sections.title: Type and layout
sections.intro: Text styles, control geometry and flow spacing. Each changes with density: set `data-density` on any container, and everything inside it follows.

sections.title: Component tokens
sections.intro: The tokens one component reads, by density. Primitiv's stylesheets use these; restyle a component through its own custom properties, listed on its page, rather than overriding these.
